title: Bind self-modification claims to executable evidence

donor_sources.observation: Extracted notes are free-form strings; sources are recorded at retrieval level, and each context is truncated to its first 500 characters.

mechanism: Typed claims bind immutable source spans and behavioral receipts to resident procedure identities.
challenge: A passing test from the old procedure must not validate its replacement, and a fabricated quotation must not resolve.

title: Investigate the missing obligations of a self-rewrite

donor_sources.observation: The next query uses accumulated notes and a hop number; there is no explicit representation of unanswered obligations or coverage.

mechanism: An explicit obligation frontier chooses investigations that can establish replacement correctness.
challenge: An optimization supported only by average latency must remain incomplete while cancellation and ownership obligations are unresolved.

title: Resolve conflicting explanations through directed retrieval

donor_sources.observation: All notes accumulate together; contradictory statements do not trigger a targeted distinguishing query or separate hypotheses.

mechanism: Conflict records generate discriminating retrieval queries before a self-rewrite rationale is accepted.
challenge: A stale design document and current execution trace disagree about a lock; the reasoner must inspect the actual revision and call path.

title: Prevent copied evidence from becoming false consensus

donor_sources.observation: Results from different retrievers are merged by raw score; no originating-source or copied-content independence is modeled.

mechanism: Evidence families separate relevance and repetition from independent corroboration of rewrite hypotheses.
challenge: Twenty copied performance summaries must not outweigh one independent failing execution.

title: Stop self-investigation when retrieval adds no knowledge

donor_sources.observation: The loop always attempts num_hops, continues after errors, and reports configured hop_count rather than successful information-gathering steps.

mechanism: A bounded retrieval controller measures novel evidence and obligation progress instead of fixed hop count.
challenge: Repeated mirrors and paraphrased queries must stop without falsely increasing confidence or exhausting the entire turn.

title: Retrieve typed evidence from the resident runtime and source corpus

donor_sources.observation: A generic source string and raw score combine heterogeneous results without typed joins, calibrated ranking, or execution identity.

mechanism: Structured predicates and actual lexical or semantic retrieval produce typed evidence for self-investigation.
challenge: A similarly named function in another revision must not outrank the exact failing invocation merely because its prose matches.

title: Extract evidence that survives different chunk boundaries

donor_sources.observation: Aggregation deduplicates normalized strings, records chunk starts rather than exact spans, and counts entity and bias occurrences repeatedly across overlaps.

mechanism: Canonical source spans make learned claims independent of chunking and overlapping observation windows.
challenge: The same assertion straddling two windows must count once, while two real occurrences remain distinguishable.

title: Distinguish real contradictions from revision and time changes

donor_sources.observation: Claims retain text and chunk location but no temporal validity, revision scope, typed predicate, or cross-document contradiction relation.

mechanism: Typed claim scopes expose unresolved contradictions without erasing historical truths.
challenge: A function safe in revision A and unsafe in revision B is a change, while simultaneous incompatible claims about B are a conflict.

title: Preserve modality and attribution in learned memory

donor_sources.observation: The extractor distinguishes claims, beliefs and utterances, but document aggregation discards utterances and does not preserve modality or attribution relationships.

mechanism: Typed modality and quotation edges prevent hypothetical or attributed text from becoming operative procedure assumptions.
challenge: A paper quoting an unsafe recommendation to refute it must not teach the runtime to adopt that recommendation.

title: Invalidate learned conclusions when their content dependencies change

donor_sources.observation: Analysis keys use PDF path, chunk size, overlap and model, omitting source content, extractor version, prompt signature and derived-claim dependencies.

mechanism: Content-addressed derivation edges allow precise invalidation of learned procedure assumptions.
challenge: Replacing source bytes at the same path must invalidate dependent optimization conclusions without discarding independent evidence.

title: Verify decisive algorithm evidence against PDF pages and figures

donor_sources.observation: The implementation transcribes rasterized pages, applies max_pages only after rendering the whole PDF, and treats response length as its main validity check.

mechanism: Selective page verification links algorithm-adoption claims to exact visual and extracted evidence.
challenge: A missing minus sign or log-scale axis must reverse an apparently favorable algorithm comparison before adoption.

title: Make self-improvement performance claims executable

donor_sources.observation: Quality is an average of positive model-generated scores; failed chunks are omitted, and no executable dimensional or denominator checks substantiate aggregate claims.

mechanism: Structured quantities and executable estimators determine whether a resident replacement improves its stated metric.
challenge: A faster mean on fewer successful requests must not be accepted as a latency improvement for the full workload.

title: Localize its own failures through competing source hypotheses

donor_sources.observation: Perception uses keywords, planning uses input length, and reflection records response_received=True without relating failure observations to source hypotheses.

mechanism: A typed fault graph maps observed failures to source predicates and discriminating experiments.
challenge: The last logged function must not be blamed automatically when an earlier ownership transfer caused the failure.

title: Record predicted observations before running self-experiments

donor_sources.observation: Hooks carry request IDs and ordered stop decisions, but do not encode hypotheses, preregistered predictions or comparison of expected versus actual observations.

mechanism: An immutable prediction ledger prevents retrospective rewriting of what an experiment was supposed to establish.
challenge: After a failed experiment the agent cannot rewrite its original prediction and report confirmation.

title: Branch and merge competing research states without erasing dissent

donor_sources.observation: A single notes list accumulates all reasoning and final synthesis; alternative research states and contradictory supports are not separately preserved.

mechanism: Immutable research scopes support bounded competing explanations and explicit evidence-preserving merges.
challenge: Two branches choosing different replacement algorithms must merge their counterexamples rather than selecting whichever report arrived last.

title: Execute cognitive stages with typed results and bounded repair

donor_sources.observation: Actions are ordered, but handlers consume the original message; reflection unconditionally marks a response received, and the verifier exercises a mock rather than real-client reasoning.

mechanism: Explicit stage outputs make perception, planning, execution, reflection and repair operational.
challenge: A deliberately wrong execution result must cause a bounded repair or rejection, never unconditional success.

title: Preempt long self-investigation without losing cognitive state

donor_sources.observation: A single executor awaits each action; stop cancels it, results are not checkpointed, and failed prerequisites can leave descendants pending indefinitely.

mechanism: Checkpointed reasoning continuations separate responsive input from resumable long cognitive work.
challenge: A stalled retrieval during self-rewrite analysis must not lose an urgent user correction or rerun an already completed experiment on resume.

title: Require evidence-sensitive completion or explicit abstention

donor_sources.observation: Confidence is parsed from model-generated text, defaults to 50 on parsing failure, and synthesis proceeds even when no retrieval succeeded.

mechanism: Completion predicates distinguish supported resident improvement from incomplete research and unsupported confidence.
challenge: A model claiming 99 percent confidence after all retrievals fail must not mark a replacement ready.

title: Replay reasoning under controlled framing interventions

donor_sources.observation: Bias detection emits labels from the first 2,000 characters; there is no controlled intervention establishing whether framing actually changes a decision.

mechanism: Paired controlled interventions measure whether irrelevant evidence presentation changes a self-rewrite decision.
challenge: Changing a source prestige label or evidence order must not silently change adoption when facts and validity are fixed.

title: Reopen learned procedures when their evidence expires

donor_sources.observation: PDF text reuse is content-addressed, but downstream analysis and learned conclusions have no validity lease tied to runtime changes or expiring observations.

mechanism: Evidence validity monitors reopen only the learned procedures whose assumptions no longer hold.
challenge: A cached improvement validated under an old runtime configuration must stop claiming current support after that configuration changes.
